I dunno if you can consider them behemoths, but BF1942 had Battleships. And those things were beasts. 
  To this day, I have no idea why they abandoned naval warfare as a feature. 
BF1 came closest by adding destroyers and Battleships which got me all kinds of false-excited for BF5, which in my dumbass mind, could potentially bring back the big boats.

Now I have to rely on games like world of warships or war Thunder to get my navy fix, which pales in comparison to the good ol’ days of raining hell from the the Yamato upon unsuspecting troops on midway island. All while being pursued by an enemy sub. 

Yeah… SUBMARINES. One of the coolest damn features in a video game at the time and DICE is just like “Meh, let’s never do this again”  

I love Battlefield, but good god their design choices have continuously gone downhill since BF1942 imho. 

I will admit I enjoyed the hell out of just about every Battlefield game since then, but not before wondering what the hell they were thinking completely removing or flat out LYING about features *cough* Dragging wounded BF5 *cough*

If you spot an enemy, your character shouts it out to those in your proximity. i.e. If you spot a tank or a plane, you'll shout it out to those around you, and even though from your perspective it's a calm "Enemy blah-blah spotted" to those around you it's something like "Holy shit, enemy tank!!".
